info.title: NXStationB
info.author: jiraiya78
info.description: Nintendo Switch port of Batocera Emulati
info.details:
## What it is

A port of Batocera’s EmulationStation (GPL) to libnx. It is **not** a reskin of NXStation (Borealis). It is the Batocera UI, scraper, themes, and gamelists running on Switch.

- **Open source roots:** Batocera ES is GPL. Switch port sources will be released in due time.
- **Stock RetroArch** (`sdmc:/switch/retroarch_switch.nro` + `sdmc:/retroarch/cores/`). Rax is optional.
- **ScreenScraper only** (set your website login in Scraper settings).
- **Title Override required** (hold **R** on a game). Album / applet mode does not have enough RAM.

## Install

1. Copy `NXStationB.nro` to `sdmc:/switch/nxstationb/NXStationB.nro`.
2. Hold **R** on any installed title and launch the NRO from hbmenu.
3. ROMs go in `sdmc:/roms/{system}/` (same as NXStation / ES-DE).
